raw_market.question: 2Q Spread: Broncos (-2.5)
raw_market.description:
In the second quarter of the NFL game between Broncos and Chargers, scheduled for October 11 at 4:05 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Broncos" if the Broncos outscore the Chargers by 3 or more points in the second quarter.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Chargers".

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
